faq: Will you edit the live site directly?
No. We work on a staging copy and show you a preview. When you approve, we move the changes to the live site, or give you the files to deploy yourself.
Do you work with Olivero, Claro or custom themes?
Yes, with core themes, contributed themes and custom ones. If you have a custom theme, a staging copy and the code repository make the work faster and safer.
Can you fix a theme that broke after an update?
Yes. We find which template or style no longer matches the new version and repair it. We check for related problems before we call the work finished.
Do I need to give you admin access?
We need a staging copy and either admin access or the theme code. We never need your password. You can add a temporary account for us and remove it after.
